categories.name: Release A
categories.description: Represents the standard discharge pathway for patients after successful treatment and admission, contributing to avoiding post-discharge deterioration and measured against post-discharge ER return.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative Release A (id=17) as observed in multiple variants such as V0008, supporting softgoal Avoid post-discharge deterioration via help contributions and evaluated against Indicator id=26.

categories.name: Release B
categories.description: Represents an alternative discharge pathway following inpatient care, contributing to avoiding post-discharge deterioration and measured against post-discharge ER return.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative Release B (id=18) as observed in variants like V0068 and V0145, supporting softgoal Avoid post-discharge deterioration via help contributions and evaluated against Indicator id=26.

categories.name: Release C
categories.description: Represents a distinct discharge pathway for complex or long-stay inpatient cases, measured against post-discharge ER return.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative Release C (id=19) as observed in variant V0710, evaluated against Indicator id=26.

categories.name: Release D
categories.description: Represents an alternative discharge pathway following extended inpatient care, measured against post-discharge ER return.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative Release D (id=20) as observed in variant V0273, evaluated against Indicator id=26.

categories.name: Release E
categories.description: Represents a specific release pathway under the captured discharge goal, measured against post-discharge ER return.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative Release E (id=21) as part of the OR decomposition under goal id=6, evaluated against Indicator id=26.
